text: The protocol requires 15N2 isotope validation, argon blank controls, contamination checks of electrolyte and gas lines, and NOx screening before assigning electrochemical N2 reduction to NH3.
notes: Synthetic eNRR protocol and validation span.

text: In the lithium-mediated N2 reduction experiment, the divided cell produced NH3 at 10.5 nmol s-1 cm-2 with 62% faradaic efficiency at 5.0 mA cm-2, and 15N2 labeling confirmed the nitrogen source.
For nitrate reduction, the Cu catalyst in 0.1 M KOH with 10 mM NO3- reached 85% faradaic efficiency for NH3 at -0.35 V vs RHE and sustained operation for 12 h.
